title: Bank Deposit Release, Compliance Holds, Information Requests and Deposit Confirmation
content:
A Bank Deposit transfer is released to the payout partner once its principal is collected, or earlier for ACH-funded principal within the account's early-release allowance under the Personal Sender Account funding rules, and once any new-recipient cooling-off has run. Release books the first payout, payout attempt 1, at the transfer's locked exchange rate.

## Holds

- Compliance, funding review, partner screening or a new-recipient cooling-off may hold a transfer before or after release. The hold reason and the moment the hold was placed are recorded on the transfer.
- A hold whose reason is a request for information about the transfer asks the customer for information about this transfer.
- Only compliance releases a hold, within the tier's hold review time in Paloma business days of a complete answer. The agent never releases a hold.
- On release from a hold, the date of availability is re-disclosed as the release day plus the tier's delivery time in Paloma business days, counted as at booking.

## Answers to a request for information

- The customer answers by uploading a document in the app, and a support agent logs the answer by its upload reference.
- An answer is logged only while the transfer is on hold with the reason "request for information about the transfer". The status and hold reason are read from the transfer record.
- Each upload reference is logged once; an upload reference already logged on the case file is not logged again.

## Cancellation of a held transfer by Paloma

A transfer held by compliance is cancelled by Paloma only when its request for information has gone unanswered for more than the tier's answer period in calendar days after the hold was placed, or when compliance rejects it. The answer period is counted in calendar days from the date part of the moment the hold was placed, and an answer logged on that date plus the answer period is on time.

| Hypothetical case (tier with a 10-day answer period; hold placed on day D) | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Answer logged on D plus 9 | on time |
| Answer logged on D plus 10 | on time (last day) |
| No answer by the end of D plus 10 | the request has gone unanswered for more than 10 days; Paloma may cancel |
| Compliance rejects the transfer on D plus 3 | Paloma may cancel |

## Payout and deposit

- A payout that fails for a technical reason is retried up to the tier's automatic retry figure before it is treated as a return.
- When the beneficiary bank confirms the credit, the transfer is deposited, with its deposit date and closing date set to that date, and Paloma Rewards points are earned under the Paloma Rewards rules.
